intent: A compact status for AI agents in headers and list rows: idle, running with a live clock, needs you, failed, done. The width springs between states, the live dot is the only ambient motion, and a click opens recent activity with the action the state is asking for.

stack.animation: motion/react (animated width on a measured content span, AnimatePresence popLayout for label and clock swaps, useInView to pause the ping and clock offscreen)

layout.pill: [dot] label | clock, fully rounded button with an animated width inside an overflow-hidden clip; content span is w-max and measured with ResizeObserver
layout.sm: 24px tall, padding 0 9px, gap 6px, 12px label, 11px clock, 6px dot, 9px separator
layout.md: 30px tall, padding 0 12px, gap 7px, 13px label, 12px clock, 7px dot, 11px separator
layout.panel: absolute below (or above) the pill, aligned to its end, width min(19rem, 100vw - 2rem), radius 12px, padding 14px; heading row, summary, mono command well, activity list with a 2.25rem time column, actions footer split by a hairline
layout.demo: 640px card: header with monogram, breadcrumb, title and the md pill; 'Other runs' list of four rows with sm pills; rows raise z-index while their panel is open, the last two open upward

color.approach: monochrome first; only the dot carries hue, and only needs-you and failed tint the pill itself because they ask the user to act
color.states: idle #71717a hollow ring; running = ink with a ping; waiting #f5a524 with a slower ping; error #f2555a; done #3fcf8e
color.tint: label color-mix(tone 74%, ink) on dark, 52% on light; surface tone 9% over the base surface; ring tone 34%
color.dark: ink #f4f4f5, muted #a1a1aa, faint #71717a, surface white 4.5%, ring white 10%, highlight white 6%, hover white 8%, panel #111113, panel ring white 9%, well #09090b
color.light: ink #18181b, muted #52525b, surface ink 4%, ring ink 12%, panel #ffffff, well #f4f4f5
color.tokens: exposed as --asp-* custom properties on the wrapper; `tones` overrides a state colour
color.demo: #000 stage, #0b0b0c card, white 8% hairlines, #8a8a93 muted text, #18181b monogram tile

motion.width: animates to the measured content width, spring stiffness 500 damping 40
motion.labelSwap: popLayout cross-fade: in from y 5px + 3px blur over 240ms ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1], out to y -5px over 160ms ease-in
motion.dot: fill and ring animate in 240ms; running ping scale 1 to 2.9, opacity 0.55 to 0, 1.6s; waiting ping 2.4s; paused offscreen
motion.clock: ticks every second only while open-ended and in view; renders after mount
motion.press: translateY 1px over 100ms; hover surface fades in over 150ms
motion.panel: hover opens once the pointer rests for 380ms (each move restarts the wait), closes 140ms after leave unless pinned; in from y -6px, scale 0.98, blur 4px over 220ms; out 140ms; activity rows stagger 45ms
motion.reducedMotion: no ping, no blur or offsets, width set instantly, 150ms opacity fades
motion.demoEntrance: once at 30% in view: card rises 12px out of an 8px blur over 0.5s, header 80ms, label 160ms, rows from 220ms 60ms apart

responsive.pill: intrinsic width; never wraps (whitespace-nowrap); 44px touch target at both sizes
responsive.panel: capped at 100vw - 2rem so it never overflows a phone
responsive.demo: card fluid to 640px; titles and tasks truncate so the pill keeps its place at 320px

accessibility: button with aria-haspopup=dialog, aria-expanded and aria-controls
panel is a non-modal role=dialog labelled '{agent}: {heading}', placed after the pill in the tab order
visually hidden role=status announces state changes only, never the clock
Esc closes the panel and returns focus to the pill; a press outside closes a pinned panel
clock is a <time> with an ISO 8601 duration
2px ink focus outline offset 2px, keyboard only; hover has a click and tap equivalent

content.demoFeatured: Fixer, 'Migrate billing webhooks to v2', waiting 1:14 on a 6:12 run: 'Approve a migration?' with `pnpm prisma migrate deploy`, Deny and Approve
demoRows: lint-sweeper · Fix 23 ESLint warnings in packages/ui · running
test-doctor · Quarantine the flaky checkout e2e suite · failed
dep-bot · Weekly dependency bump · idle, Run now

avoid: gradients, glows or glass around the pill
a spinner beside the dot or a pulsing label
the width jumping between states, or text scaled by a layout animation
announcing the ticking clock to screen readers
decorative pills that assert a quality rather than report a state
